About the Home

Every child deserves a home that holds steady.

Lighthouse Children Welfare Home Association gives shelter to children and young people who have nowhere safe to go. For many, this is the first place where meals are regular, bedtime is calm and an adult is always nearby.

The Home is run by a dedicated committee and caregivers, and depends on the generosity of Malaysians to cover food, schooling, medical care and the daily running costs of three homes across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor.

Questions

Before you give

Is my donation safe?

Give only by bank transfer to the account shown on our donate page, and confirm the details by calling us first. We never ask for donations through personal accounts.

Will I get a receipt?

[confirm] Send your transfer slip with your name and email and we will acknowledge your gift. Confirm tax-receipt policy with the Home.

Can I give clothes, toys or books?

Yes. Please call or WhatsApp ahead so we can tell you what is needed most right now.

Can I visit or volunteer?

We welcome volunteers who can tutor, mentor or share a skill. Visits are arranged in advance to protect the children's privacy and routine.
